# Jessie on a Journey

> > Award-winning travel blog by Jessie Festa featuring adventure travel guides, hiking experiences, and destination planning tools for independent travelers exploring Nepal, South America, Europe, and beyond.

Jessie on a Journey is a solo female travel blog that has been featured in USA TODAY, CNN, Forbes, Business Insider, BBC Travel, and other major media outlets. The site specializes in adventure travel, hiking guides, and practical travel planning resources with a focus on empowering independent travelers.

## Key Topics

- Nepal
- South America
- Bhutan
- Europe
- Annapurna Himalayas
- Azores
- Adventure travel
- Solo female travel
- Hiking and trekking
- Travel planning
- Destination guides
- Budget travel tools
- Trail recommendations
- World travel guides

## Travel Destination Guides

- [Travel Guides From Around The World | Where I've Been Map](https://jessieonajourney.com/where-ive-been/): Interactive world map showing visited destinations and travel guides

## Travel Planning Tools

- [Free Road Trip Budget Calculator](https://jessieonajourney.com/road-trip-budget-calculator/): Road trip expense tracking and budgeting tool
- [Free Cruise Trip Budget Calculator](https://jessieonajourney.com/cruise-trip-budget-calculator/): Cruise expense tracking and budgeting calculator
- [Free Backpacking Budget Calculator](https://jessieonajourney.com/backpacking-budget-calculator/): Backpacking trip budgeting and expense management tool
